description: A calm story short: pictures that never park, a few hard cuts on the beat. Measured on the encoded file at 30 fps. stillDelta 6: a pixel counts as moved when it changes by more than 6 of 255 grey levels between two frames at 320 px wide (at 4, compression noise and glow drift count as movement and a parked shot reads 0.2% still; at 6 the same shot reads 9.7%). stillShare 0.002: a frame is still when under 0.2% of its pixels moved, the sensitive reading a slow camera push needs. endCardSeconds 3.7: the end card (6 beats, 3.6 s at 100 BPM) plus 0.1 s, left out of the still, hold and cut counts so the cut into it is not counted; set it to the card's length plus 0.1. stillShareMax 0.04: at most 4% of the film's frames may be still (the starter measures 0.0%; its deliberately parked draft, a lamp shot with no edges, measured 9.7%). holdMax 0.8: no still run over 0.8 s, because a plate pushes the whole time (the starter's longest is 0.00 s; the parked draft held 1.23 s). cutsPer10s 2 to 6: hard cuts per 10 s the measurement sees, the style's rule; the starter measures 2.5 (5 cuts in 20.3 s: a cut is seen when about half the frame changes by more than 24 grey levels and the mean brightness jumps by 18, so its sixth cut, a cut-in between two bright morning shots, is not counted). levelMax 5.2 and hardwareDecode: the H.264 level and a clean play on the Mac's decoder. audio required, loudness -16 to -12 LUFS and true peak -1 dBTP: the mix is mastered at -14 and -1.
